title: Civic Roles, Energy Future, Legal Moves
summary:
Here's a summary of the meeting:

*   Discussions took place regarding recommendations for a statewide energy plan, though no formal resolution was adopted at this session.
*   Numerous citizens were appointed to a wide array of city boards and commissions, including those focused on the Airport, Economic Development, Environmental issues, Human Rights, and Child Care.
*   An executive session was held to discuss sensitive matters, including pending litigation, potential land acquisitions, and progress on the search for a new City Manager and municipal court judge and clerk appointments.
